recipe.visualDefinition: A high-action, low-angle shot of a shaggy, dog-shaped van jumping over a road, with two comedic characters leaning out of the windows against a dense green forest background.
coreVisualRelationships: The van's upward trajectory creates a sense of kinetic energy.
The characters' exaggerated expressions mirror the absurdity of the vehicle.
The dark forest background provides high contrast for the tan fur of the van.
The road at the bottom anchors the composition and provides a launch point.
coreInvariants: The shaggy, carpet-like texture of the vehicle
The low-angle perspective looking up at the undercarriage
The bright, saturated red and blue color scheme in the title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The shaggy van is the central, dominant subject, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark undercarriage and wheels of the van provide a heavy visual base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the road at the bottom, up through the jumping van, to the characters' faces, and finally to the top text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense foliage fills the sides and top, creating a frame-within-a-frame effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green (background) and tan/beige (vehicle fur).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (undercarriage and windows) provides depth and separation.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red (tongue and title elements) and blue (title) for high-energy focus.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright sky/fur and the dark shadows under the van.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain earthy tones for the background

letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky strokes with minimal negative space in counters
Slightly irregular baselines for a playful feel
Integrated graphic elements like rotated characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' in the second word is mirrored or flipped
The 'TO' is encased in a red circular badge with a white outline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face for the title paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Red rectangular box for the word 'AND'

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky presence.
Clean geometric structure for the metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle shot of a tan, shaggy-furred van jumping into the air on a paved road with yellow lines. Two men with funny expressions lean out the side windows. The background is a dense, dark green forest. Dust and debris are kicked up from the road.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold sans-serif title at the bottom in blue and red. Flip one 'B' character. Add a small white sans-serif line of text at the very top with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the van's texture clearly shaggy fur?
Is the 'B' in the title mirrored?
Is the camera angle low enough to see the undercarriage?
Is the top text centered and wide-tracked?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the road perspective matches the van's angle
Verify the title colors are vibrant and saturated
Confirm the 'AND' box is correctly placed
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle action shot + textured vehicle + bold, modified display typography = Slapstick Comedy Aesthetic.
